    ordered neighbors is picked last among ties, as LexBFS requires.

                for t in range(i):
                    d = order[t]
                    if A[d][b] and not A[d][c]:
                        ok = True

    2. Try moving u to every other position. If valid, done.

    return {'ordering': repaired}
